title: HtmlDiv
responsibility: Renders the native div element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlDiv.attributes
inputs.description: Native div attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlDiv.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native div element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlDiv
outputs.description: The actual native div element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
